messages.subject: nimble workshop in Lisbon, 1-3 June
parts:
In case anyone is interested, there is still space in a nimble workshop to be held in Lisbon in about two months, 1-3 June.  It is not ecology-specific but would be of interest to users wanting to advance their skills.
https://nimbleworkshop.weebly.com/
-Perry
